items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: He was a piano player that really wrote the part of my book.

ctx.x: He'd go there every night when Juanita would go off to play at this club. He'd go there and sit on the outside to keep Fats company. And Fats was on the last thing. Because he needed to see him alone.

Oh yeah. Well she would tell me to watch Fats. You know, I'd call her and she says, Come on over, I'm going to work. So I'd get over there and all the doors are locked. And so I'd go to the window and I'd eat that. I could raise his head up and tell him my cousin. I said, I don't worry about nothing. I said, if you get to the place where you really need me, I'm breaking the window. I said, well I need him locked all the house. When I'd come back she'd be all surprised. Thought she had left everything and all…
He never got the plan that the rest of his family did, huh?
